articles.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
articles.snippet: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
articles.snippet: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

articles.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
articles.snippet: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
articles.snippet: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.
